source.name: US Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2024 5-year estimates

notes: effectivePropertyTaxRate = median real estate taxes paid / median home value. This is an EFFECTIVE rate as actually experienced, not a statutory millage rate — it already reflects assessment ratios, homestead exemptions and caps.
Figures are metro-wide medians. A specific home may differ substantially, which is why every housing field is editable in the interface.
